title: Can a global database of fossils help us predict the future of biodiversity on Earth?
subtitle: The history of life on Earth includes five major extinction episodes, which have each destroyed at least three quarters of all species, followed by life's resurgence. Whether we are now living through a sixth episode is not certain as we don't have a clear picture of how life changes between extinction events, or what has happened in previous episodes. A new project aims to fill some of the gaps.
